title: Complex systems.
Made legible.
portfolio.label: THE PORTFOLIO
portfolio.caption: A home for the work, the reasoning, and the person behind it.
portfolio.build: Next.js, React, TypeScript, and CSS shape a focused project showcase. The personal hub is a separate destination.
portfolio.evidence_note: Published showcase and navigation inspected. Earlier particle and test-count claims describe a previous iteration, not this deployed interface.

title: Read the texture.
Question the image.
vision.label: AI VS. REAL
vision.caption: Handcrafted texture features. A classifier you can inspect.
vision.build: Grayscale input is resized to 224 by 224. LBP, GLCM, and noise features are standardized before SVM classification. The public deployment uses Flask; Streamlit is the local interface.
vision.evidence_note: The 78% held-out result and sub-two-second local inference are resume-reported. The repository reports approximately 77-80% accuracy on a curated dataset. This visit verified the upload interface, not inference or generalization.

title: Model the roof.
Expose the reasoning.
zenith.label: YOR ZENITH
zenith.caption: From rooftop inputs to an inspectable solar feasibility model.
zenith.build: The product brings rooftop planning, energy modeling, and financial assumptions into a decision-support workflow.
zenith.evidence_note: The published interface was inspected. Financial projections are model estimates, not guarantees. This review did not validate tariff, subsidy, or investment assumptions, or complete an authenticated analysis.

title: Signals into
decisions.
helios.label: YOR HELIOS
helios.caption: Realtime energy monitoring. In development.
helios.build: FastAPI and WebSocket connections route anomaly and threshold events into channel-specific dashboards, with Docker Compose for the local environment.
helios.evidence_note: Public repository available. No public deployment or end-to-end demonstration was verified. The signal illustration is an architecture motif, not live telemetry.

title: People, connected.
talks.label: YOR TALKS V2
talks.caption: Typed interfaces meet conversations, feeds, and communities.
talks.build: React and Vite connect to an Express and Socket.IO API. Shared TypeScript packages, Postgres, and Drizzle support the application. Provider-backed functionality depends on deployment configuration.
talks.evidence_note: Current repository documentation confirms the stack. This profile review did not sign in or verify message delivery, moderation, payments, or production readiness.

title: An emotional
interface.
feelings.label: YOR FEELINGS
feelings.caption: A smaller lab for sentiment and expressive interaction.
feelings.build: An experimental exploration of mood-responsive interface state.
feelings.evidence_note: The recorded deployment currently presents an Echo-branded campus application. The gallery links to the project source rather than presenting that destination as a verified Feelings demo.
